Interface JsonAdapter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - java type adapted by this interface
public interface JsonAdapter<T>
Adapts a java type to a structural JsonElement representation.

Implementations of this interface can provide custom JSON tree conversion when consumed by JsonElement.Type.of(Object) and related JSON tree-building APIs.

This contract is limited to conversion between java objects and JsonElement values. It does not define JSON text serialization.

      static <T> void register(Class<T> type, JsonAdapter<? super T> adapter)

    • toJsonText

      default JsonElement toJsonText(T object)
      Converts the specified java object to a human-oriented JSON representation.

      The returned value is still a JsonElement, but it may favor readability over faithful reconstruction of the original object.

      The default implementation reuses toJson(Object).

      The default contract accepts null values and should return null for them.

      Parameters:
      object - java object to be converted
      Returns:
      a text-oriented JSON representation of the specified object
